title: Chapter 131 The Black Iron City Brick Problem
content:
Chapter 131 The Black Iron City Brick Problem

Thinking of this, he found the blacksmith Matar.

"Lord, what do you want from me?" Matar trotted over and saluted Wang Shuo.

"Mr. Matar, I need a lot of iron fans, do you have any idea?" Wang Shuo asked worriedly.

"Well, this is not difficult. We still have more than 4W units of iron ore. We just need to grind it into powder. I will organize the manpower to make iron powder."

"I'm sorry to trouble you. In addition, I also have a blueprint for the construction of a light catapult. You should also study it and try to manufacture it as soon as possible."

Wang Shuo took out the blueprint from his backpack and handed it to Matar.

The latter's face was filled with joy. He liked this kind of drawing very much. Since he had not had the opportunity to obtain such a high-level drawing before, he showed a look of joy as soon as he got the drawing.

However, after looking at it for a while, he frowned and said with a hint of embarrassment: "Lord, I cannot complete this large siege equipment alone. It requires the cooperation of a carpenter, and the carpentry skills required for it. More skills than a blacksmith."

"Well, what should we do?"

"I suggest that the lord set up a carpentry workshop. This catapult can be jointly researched by the blacksmith shop and the carpentry workshop."

"Okay, I'll do as you said. Now you go to the Chief Controller Duan Wenxi to discuss this matter. I hope to see your results as soon as possible." Wang Shuo nodded and said solemnly.

"Yes, Lord Lord."

After solving the problem of iron fans, Wang Shuo called Yan Fujie and Banrick again.

"From now on, the three of us will start practicing how to draw defensive runes."

"Yes." Both of them had expressions of surprise on their faces.

For such an important matter to be left to two people to participate, it was obvious that he was appreciated and reused by the lord.

Wang Shuo discovered that Yan Fujie's loyalty had already reached 100 points, and Banrick's loyalty had also risen to 96 points at this time.

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction.

Next, Wang Shuo found a tent and asked Duan Wenxi to send some blood of the bronze boss over, and the three of them started practicing.

Wang Shuo opened the "City Wall Construction Manual" and turned to the defense runes page.

Only a honeycomb-shaped hexagonal pattern appeared on the paper.

If you don't look carefully, you won't notice anything unusual.

Once you look closely, you will find that every line has a faint movement of light.

Your eyes keep moving along the direction of the lines. After looking at it for a long time, you will even feel that the entire pattern is alive, as if it is alive.

But after watching it for a long time, I feel a little dizzy.

Wang Shuo immediately turned his head and closed his eyes. At this time, the pattern in his mind was lingering.

He shook his head again, and the pattern seemed to be deeply imprinted on his mind.

His head felt slightly dizzy, and it took him a while to wake up.

"What did you two see?"

"It's just an ordinary hexagon!" Yan Fujie looked at Wang Shuo with some confusion, not knowing why.

"What about you? Have you seen anything like light?" Wang Shuo turned to look at Banrick.

The latter shook his head.

Wang Shuo was also a little confused about the situation and simply ignored it.

Sitting on the floor at a low table, Wang Shuo picked up the prepared brush and began to draw patterns on ordinary clay.

He painted every stroke very carefully.

The other two people also sat at their respective tables and began to practice.

After a long while, Wang Shuo's brushes had been replaced by five, but he was still unable to outline the charm of the book.

Wang Shuo was so angry that he threw away his pen!

"Holy shit, is it really that difficult to draw a talisman?" Wang Shuo couldn't help but feel a little angry.

The situation of the other two people was even worse than that of Wang Shuo.

Just when Wang Shuo was depressed, a system prompt sounded.

[Because you captured the bandit leader of Qingmuzhai in Wadang Mountain, Zhang Wenlong, the head of Qingmuzhai, already knows about this. In three days, they will send people to wipe out Wana Village. 】
